_note: SYNTHETIC demo data. All names, phone numbers (555-01xx), and emails (example.com) are fictional. Timestamps are relative to first startup. 'history' simulates staff actions so Business results has something to measure.

inquiries.message: Looking for an estimate to move a three-bedroom house from Sherman to McKinney on June 14. We have a piano and a large sectional.
Customer called: the truck arrived but the crew damaged the dining table while loading. He wants someone to call him today.
Hi, we're scheduled for the 21st but need to postpone our move by one week because of a lease delay. Is that possible?
Do you also sell packing boxes, or only do moves? Just curious for later.
Need a price for a studio apartment move from Denison to Durant next Friday. Elevator building.
Your movers are running late and we have not heard from anyone. The building only lets us use the elevator until 2pm.
Can I get a quote for moving a four-bedroom home from Plano to Sherman sometime next month? Flexible on dates.
Caller wants to cancel her Saturday booking and maybe rebook in the fall.
Hello, I have a question about my invoice from last month. There is a line item I don't recognize.
How much to move a two-bedroom apartment from Denison to Sherman on May 3rd? Ground floor, no large items.
We booked a move for tomorrow but the new apartment is not ready. Can we push it back to Wednesday?
Customer says items are missing after delivery yesterday: two boxes of kitchen supplies and a lamp. Very upset.
Need movers for a one-bedroom apartment. Moving from Sherman, not sure where yet. No rush.
Please send me a quote. Thanks.
